data.one_liner: Implicitly animates rotation when the provided angle changes
data.what_it_does: Provides an implicitly animated rotation widget that transitions its child widget to a new rotation angle whenever the value changes. It serves as an implicit alternative to Flutter's RotationTransition without requiring an explicit AnimationController. Users simply specify the target angle and wrap their child widget.
use_when: You need to rotate a widget smoothly when a state value changes without creating an AnimationController
You want an implicit animation for rotation in older Flutter projects where built-in AnimatedRotation might not be available
avoid_when: You are using modern Flutter SDK versions that already include the built-in AnimatedRotation widget
You need explicit, continuous, or reverse animation control that requires an AnimationController
strengths: Simple declarative API requiring only the target angle and child
Eliminates boilerplate associated with AnimationController and TickerProviderStateMixin
weaknesses: Largely redundant since Flutter introduced its own built-in AnimatedRotation widget in the core framework
Minimal configuration options documented beyond the angle and child
